items.title: III MEF Expeditionary Operations Training Group, ROK service members conduct multidomain reconnaissance course
items.description: Marines with the III Marine Expeditionary Force Expeditionary Operations Training Group (III EOTG) and service members from the Republic of Korea (ROK) military will conduct the Multi Domain Reconnaissance Course (MDRC) 26.1 throughout South Korea from 21 Oct to 06 Nov.

items.title: NAVFAC Pacific recognizes Guam Program Management Office legacy, formally concludes mission
items.description: JOINT BASE PEARL HARBOR-HICKAM, Hawaii — Naval Facilities Engineering Systems Command (NAVFAC) Pacific recognized the legacy of its Guam Program Management Office (GPMO) during an Oct. 14 ceremony marking the office’s formal mission conclusion.

items.title: Reserve Unit Helps Strengthen CNRH’s Hurricane Readiness
items.description: JOINT BASE PEARL HARBOR-HICKAM, Hawaii — After months of severe weather that brought destructive storms, flooding and repeated pressure on communities across Hawaii, Navy Region Hawaii is reinforcing hurricane readiness, supported in part by the reserve Sailors of the Regional Operations Center (ROC) under Navy Cmdr. Jason Afong’s leadership.

items.title: Brig. Gen. Landers debriefs command climate survey results at town hall
items.description: U.S. Army Brig. Gen. Andrew L. Landers, director of Defense Health Network Pacific and commanding general of Medical Readiness Command, Pacific, addressed service members and staff during a Defense Organizational Climate Survey town hall meeting at Tripler Army Medical Center, Hawaii, Oct. 19, 2026. The town hall provided a platform for leadership to discuss command climate feedback and answer questions regarding organizational improvements.

items.title: NPS Announces Nine Digital Trident II Projects Addressing Pacific Operational Challenges
items.description: The Naval Postgraduate School Office of Research and Innovation announced nine projects selected for development through the Digital Trident II initiative. Chosen through a competitive process, the projects bring NPS researchers, operational stakeholders and partners together to address consequential challenges facing U.S. forces in the Pacific.

items.title: Upload complete: Seitz realizes 50-year legacy built at MCCS Quantico
items.description: MARINE CORPS BASE QUANTICO, Va. — In 1976, 18-year-old Debra Seitz accepted what she thought would be a temporary job as a salesclerk at the Marine Corps Exchange. Five decades later, the installation she once viewed as a temporary workplace has become what she described as her second home.
items.location_display: Marine Corps Base Quantico, Virginia, United States

items.title: Direct Readiness Support: How the Hampton Roads Appointment Center is Reaching Historic Performance Highs
items.description: The Hampton Roads Appointment Center sustained major improvements in access to care, answering 99.79% of nearly 600,000 calls within 90 seconds and reducing call abandonment to 0.16% during its 2025–2026 performance period. Through staff training, performance management, and proactive specialty-referral outreach, HRAC also booked 6,400 specialty appointments and improved timely access to care for TRICARE beneficiaries across the Tidewater region.
